name: Taskbar Transparency Controller
description: Makes the taskbar clear, blurred, acrylic or tinted — on every monitor.
author: AETHER

compatibility.notes: Uses the SetWindowCompositionAttribute window attribute (undocumented, no code injection). Windows may briefly restore the default look when the Start menu opens; AETHER re-applies the effect once per second while enabled.

settings.label: Tint color
settings.description: Alpha controls how strong the tint is.

documentation.whatItChanges: Applies a composition effect to the Shell_TrayWnd and Shell_SecondaryTrayWnd windows from the AETHER process. Nothing is written to disk.
documentation.uninstall: Disabling restores the default taskbar immediately.
documentation.limitations: Runs only while AETHER is running.
